newsitem.title: USA: U.S. MUNICIPAL FOCUS - finishes up about 1/8 point.
newsitem.headline: U.S. MUNICIPAL FOCUS - finishes up about 1/8 point.

text.p: The U.S. municipal market was flat to up about 1/8 point in light secondary action, as players cited a strong showing in the face of heavy supply.
"All in all it feels a little firmer," one trader said. The market outperformed Treasuries, where the long bond was off 5/32 at 101-1/32 to yield 6.42 percent.
Traders said the strong showing came despite the week's roughly $4 billion of new bonds, which were extremely well-received. Most of the larger deals saw repricings to lower yields.
PaineWebber Inc cut yields on the largest negotiated deal to price Thursday, a California Health Facilities Financing Authority issue totalling $34 million, sold for Catholic Healthcare West.
At the repricing, PaineWebber lowered yields in several maturities and cut the top yield in 2023 to 5.62 percent from 5.65 percent. To see the repricing scale, double click on nN21228304.

In competitive action, JP Morgan Securities said it had a $28.8 million balance on Clark County School District, Nev.'s $40 million general obligation bond issue, which the firm won in competitive bidding Thursday. To see the remaining

In the muni secondary, bids on Cook County, Ill., FGIC 5-7/8s of 2022 were up 1/8 at 110-7/8, after being quoted unchanged at midday. Texas Turnpike Authority FGIC 5-1/4s of 2023 were down one basis point to 5.56 percent net.

In futures action Thursday, the December municipal contract closed down 2/32 to 117-20/32 while December T-bonds fell 6/32 to 115-17/32. The MOB spread widened to 67 ticks from 63 at the close Wednesday.
